steps.text: I found the regression: option rows are keyed by their display label, so repeated labels create duplicate React keys and reconciliation reuses the wrong rows as the filter shrinks. I’m applying the upstream-compatible `getOptionKey` escape hatch and its regression coverage.

Implemented the duplicate-option fix.

- Added `getOptionKey` to provide stable unique keys when option labels repeat.
- Wired it through Material, Joy, and `useAutocomplete` typings.
- Added Material and TypeScript regression coverage.

Changed: [useAutocomplete.js](/testbed/packages/mui-base/src/useAutocomplete/useAutocomplete.js:1168), [Autocomplete.js](/testbed/packages/mui-material/src/Autocomplete/Autocomplete.js:414), and tests.

Validation: formatting and `git diff --check` pass. Focused test and base TypeScript suite are blocked by existing environment dependency conflicts (read-only `navigator` in JSDOM; duplicate React type definitions).
